title: Ample rank-two bundles on the quadric surface without Griffiths-positive metrics

abstractEnglish: We give counterexamples to Griffiths' conjecture in rank two on the quadric surface $`\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1`$. We construct an explicit bundle G whose coordinatewise power pullbacks, tensored with $`\mathcal O(1,1)`$, are ample for every positive power, but admit no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric for all sufficiently large powers.
